1: using System.Text.Json;
2: 
3: namespace IntentSystem.Cli.Commands;
4: 
5: internal static class CrossRuntimeReviewJsonlVerdict
6: {
7:     internal static bool TryReadCopilotObservedModel(string content, out string? observedModel, out string error)
8:     {
9:         observedModel = null;
10:         if (!TryReadCopilotEnvelope(content, out _, out observedModel, out _, out error))
11:         {
12:             return false;
13:         }
14: 
15:         error = string.Empty;
16:         return observedModel is not null;
17:     }
18: 
19:     internal static bool TryParseCopilot<TVerdict>(
20:         string content,
21:         CrossRuntimeReviewVerdict.TryValidateDelegate<TVerdict> validate,
22:         out TVerdict verdict,
23:         out string? observedModel,
24:         out string error)
25:     {
26:         verdict = default!;
27:         observedModel = null;
28:         if (!TryReadCopilotEnvelope(content, out _, out observedModel, out var answerText, out error))
29:         {
30:             return false;
31:         }
32: 
33:         if (!CrossRuntimeReviewVerdict.TryParseTrailingObject(answerText, out var inner))
34:         {
35:             error = "verdict-invalid: copilot final_answer content does not end with a verdict JSON object.";
36:             return false;
37:         }
38: 
39:         using (inner)
40:         {
41:             return validate(inner.RootElement, out verdict, out error);
42:         }
43:     }
44: 
45:     private static bool TryReadCopilotEnvelope(
46:         string content,
47:         out JsonElement? finalAnswer,
48:         out string? observedModel,
49:         out string answerText,
50:         out string error)
51:     {
52:         finalAnswer = null;
53:         observedModel = null;
54:         answerText = string.Empty;
55:         if (!TryReadJsonLines(content, out var lines, out error))
56:         {
57:             return false;
58:         }
59: 
60:         if (lines.Count == 1
61:             && lines[0].RootElement.TryGetProperty(CrossRuntimeReviewVerdict.FieldVerdict, out _)
62:             && !lines[0].RootElement.TryGetProperty("type", out _))
63:         {
64:             error = "copilot requires the runtime JSON envelope from the pinned invocation; a bare verdict object is refused.";
65:             return false;
66:         }
67: 
68:         JsonElement? resultEvent = null;
69:         var resultCount = 0;
70:         var finalAnswerCount = 0;
71: 
72:         for (var lineNumber = 1; lineNumber <= lines.Count; lineNumber++)
73:         {
74:             var root = lines[lineNumber - 1].RootElement;
75:             if (root.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Object)
76:             {
77:                 error = $"verdict-invalid: line {lineNumber} must be a JSON object with a string 'type'.";
78:                 return false;
79:             }
80: 
81:             if (!root.TryGetProperty("type", out var typeElement) || typeElement.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.String)
82:             {
83:                 error = $"verdict-invalid: line {lineNumber} must be a JSON object with a string 'type'.";
84:                 return false;
85:             }
86: 
87:             var type = typeElement.GetString()!;
88:             if (string.Equals(type, "result", StringComparison.Ordinal))
89:             {
90:                 resultCount++;
91:                 resultEvent = root;
92:             }
93:             else if (string.Equals(type, "assistant.message", StringComparison.Ordinal))
94:             {
95:                 if (!root.TryGetProperty("data", out var data))
96:                 {
97:                     continue;
98:                 }
99: 
100:                 if (data.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Object)
101:                 {
102:                     error = $"verdict-invalid: line {lineNumber} assistant.message event must have an object data.";
103:                     return false;
104:                 }
105: 
106:                 if (data.TryGetProperty("phase", out var phase)
107:                     && phase.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.String
108:                     && string.Equals(phase.GetString(), "final_answer", StringComparison.Ordinal))
109:                 {
110:                     finalAnswerCount++;
111:                     finalAnswer = root;
112:                 }
113:             }
114:         }
115: 
116:         if (resultCount != 1 || resultEvent is null)
117:         {
118:             error = "verdict-invalid: exactly one 'result' event must be present and be the last event.";
119:             return false;
120:         }
121: 
122:         if (!string.Equals(lines[^1].RootElement.GetProperty("type").GetString(), "result", StringComparison.Ordinal))
123:         {
124:             error = "verdict-invalid: the last event must be the only 'result' event.";
125:             return false;
126:         }
127: 
128:         if (!resultEvent.Value.TryGetProperty("exitCode", out var exitCode)
129:             || exitCode.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Number
130:             || !exitCode.TryGetInt32(out var exitCodeValue)
131:             || exitCodeValue != 0)
132:         {
133:             error = "verdict-invalid: the 'result' event must have exitCode 0.";
134:             return false;
135:         }
136: 
137:         if (finalAnswerCount != 1 || finalAnswer is null)
138:         {
139:             error = "verdict-invalid: exactly one 'assistant.message' event must have data.phase == \"final_answer\".";
140:             return false;
141:         }
142: 
143:         if (!finalAnswer.Value.TryGetProperty("data", out var answerData) || answerData.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Object)
144:         {
145:             error = "verdict-invalid: the final_answer event must have an object data with a string data.content.";
146:             return false;
147:         }
148: 
149:         if (!answerData.TryGetProperty("content", out var contentElement) || contentElement.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.String)
150:         {
151:             error = "verdict-invalid: the final_answer event must have a string data.content.";
152:             return false;
153:         }
154: 
155:         if (answerData.TryGetProperty("toolRequests", out var toolRequests))
156:         {
157:             if (toolRequests.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Array)
158:             {
159:                 error = "verdict-invalid: the final_answer event data.toolRequests must be absent or an empty array.";
160:                 return false;
161:             }
162: 
163:             if (toolRequests.GetArrayLength() > 0)
164:             {
165:                 error = "verdict-invalid: the final_answer event must not have non-empty data.toolRequests.";
166:                 return false;
167:             }
168:         }
169: 
170:         if (!answerData.TryGetProperty("model", out var modelElement) || modelElement.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.String)
171:         {
172:             observedModel = null;
173:         }
174:         else
175:         {
176:             observedModel = modelElement.GetString();
177:         }
178:         answerText = contentElement.GetString()!;
179:         if (ContainsMarkdownFence(answerText))
180:         {
181:             error = "verdict-invalid: copilot final_answer content must not wrap the verdict in a Markdown fence.";
182:             return false;
183:         }
184: 
185:         return true;
186:     }

188:     internal static bool TryParseCopilotEffort(string content, string observedModel, string expectedEffort, out string error)
189:     {
190:         error = string.Empty;
191:         if (!TryReadJsonLines(content, out var lines, out error))
192:         {
193:             return false;
194:         }
195: 
196:         var efforts = new List<string>();
197:         for (var lineNumber = 1; lineNumber <= lines.Count; lineNumber++)
198:         {
199:             var root = lines[lineNumber - 1].RootElement;

203:             {
204:                 continue;
205:             }
206: 
207:             if (!root.TryGetProperty("data", out var data) || data.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Object)
208:             {
209:                 continue;
210:             }
211: 
212:             if (!data.TryGetProperty("promptCacheBreakState", out var states) || states.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Array)
213:             {
214:                 continue;
215:             }
216: 
217:             foreach (var state in states.EnumerateArray())
218:             {
219:                 if (state.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Object
220:                     || !state.TryGetProperty("conversation", out var conversation)
221:                     || conversation.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.String
222:                     || conversation.GetString() != "main"
223:                     || !state.TryGetProperty("models", out var models)
224:                     || models.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Object
225:                     || !models.TryGetProperty(observedModel, out var modelState)
226:                     || modelState.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Object
227:                     || !modelState.TryGetProperty("reasoning_effort", out var effort)
228:                     || effort.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.String)
229:                 {
230:                     continue;
231:                 }

654:         builder.Append(fence);

## Objective
- Review the G842 packet (digest `ee766db9971945e29f9357e50966d387ac7f05eb5a9f714a65e23680fd6614f8`) as an independent design reviewer against the operator decisions, "Current Observed State" truth in the read-only clone, gate soundness, testability, and the no-launch rule, and emit the required JSON verdict JSON (approve or request-changes with blocking_findings/notes).

## Important Details
- Available tools are only `glob`, `grep`, `read` (no bash/shell), so commands cannot be run; verification is textual only.
- The read-only clone is at `<scratch>/g842-ac14/review-clone`; HEAD is detached at `0834364de90ad75ff1ee88151ef0b9296d0d08cd` = `refs/remotes/origin/cursor/g842-copilot-opencode-runtimes` (i.e., the G842 implementation head, not the `ba496314` base).
- Final output must be exactly one JSON object with keys `verdict`, `packet_digest`, `blocking_findings` (file/line/scenario), `notes`; verdict `approve` only with empty blocking_findings.
- Packet's core contract: five runtimes (codex, claude, cursor, copilot, opencode) symmetric across conductor/reviewer/builder; pinned read-only invocations with isolated homes/config dirs; JSONL verdict envelope rules (copilot: single `final_answer` before last `result` exitCode 0, `data.model == --model`, effort from `session.usage_checkpoint` `promptCacheBreakState[main].models[...].reasoning_effort`; opencode: T1–T11 state machine, seat-reported model/effort); `--model` required for copilot/opencode, optional `--effort`; no-launch source guard (textual, whole-identifier tokens, pinned per-file counts vs `ba496314`); twelve AC15 mutations (a)–(l); back-compat byte-identity for codex/claude/cursor.

## Work State
### Completed
- Confirmed head is the G842 implementation (not base); G842 files/tests present.
- `CrossRuntimeReviewRuntimes.cs`: `All` order codex, claude, cursor, copilot, opencode (line 18); `Describe()` = "codex, claude, cursor, copilot, or opencode" (line 38); `RequiresModel`/`AcceptsEffort` only for copilot/opencode; Copilot effort levels `none, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, max`; opencode provider regex `^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*$`.
- `CrossRuntimeReviewJsonlVerdict.cs`: `TryParseCopilot` (result-last/exitCode-0/final_answer/data.model checks; `TryParseTrailingObject` reuse; fence refusal), `TryParseCopilotEffort` (usage_checkpoint main-conversation reasoning_effort, mismatch when absent/different), `TryParseOpencode` (state machine T1 error-first-any-state → T2 terminated-any-event → T3 idle+step_start → T4 idle+step_finish/text/tool_use → T5 open+step_start → T6 open+step_finish stop → T7 other finish→idle → T8 open+text append → T9 open+tool_use → T10 ignore → T11 EOF not-terminated/empty-buffer refuse), matching the packet's row order.
- `CrossRuntimeReviewOpencodeConfig.cs`: `ReviewerConfigJson` string; `opencode-reviewer.measured.json` fixture (45 lines) matches: `*` deny first, deny edit/bash/task/external_directory/webfetch/websearch/skill/todowrite/question/lsp/doom_loop, allow read/glob/grep/list, same at top and agent `intent-cli-reviewer`, `"mode": "primary"`, description "intent-cli read-only cross-runtime reviewer".
- `ReviewCrossRuntimeCommand.cs`: `RequestUsage` shows all five runtimes; new causes wired (`ModelRequired` line ~1504, `EffortInvalid` ~1517, `ModelMismatch` 776/1011, `EffortMismatch` 787/1022, `OpencodeProviderConfigInvalid` 164/340); implementation prompt embeds `github-body.md`, `review-context.md`, `implementation.md` verbatim for copilot/opencode (570-572) vs host paths for the other three.
- `CliConfigLoader.cs` 656-660: conductor_runtime validated via `IsSupported` (five).
- `CrossRuntimeReviewRequestSupport.cs`: `TryValidateOutDir` foreign-entry check via `RenderedFor(runtime)`, `CrossRuntimeReviewHomeAccessGuard` protection.
- `GuideSoloConductorCommand.cs`: placeholder `<codex|claude|cursor|copilot|opencode>`, `ModelRequiredPrefix = "The model is required. "`, seven-item `BuilderContractItems`, builder guidance present.
- `G842NoLaunchSourceGuardTests.cs` exists; `LaunchTokens` = the 24 packet tokens; exempt exact lines = the two seam declarations; surface pins are FIVE (ClaimOwnershipVerification 2 + ClaimOwnershipVerifier 1 in `CrossRuntimeReviewPacketClaimResolver.cs`; ClaimOwnershipVerification 3 + ClaimOwnershipVerifier 2 in `CrossRuntimeReviewTeamResolver.cs`; `INotifyProcessRunner` 1 in `ReviewCrossRuntimeCommand.cs`).

### Active
